name: macos-firewall-on
title: Turn on the application firewall
description: Turns on the macOS application firewall (socketfilterfw --setglobalstate on) and reads it back. It can block incoming connections to apps that are not signed; refuses when a configuration profile manages the firewall.
measure: if [ "$on" = yes ]; then arh_item "Application firewall" on; else arh_item "Application firewall" off; fi
if [ -e "/Library/Managed Preferences/com.apple.security.firewall.plist" ]; then arh_blocker "A configuration profile manages the firewall"; fi
if [ "$on" = yes ]; then arh_plan false "Already on"; else arh_plan true "Turn the application firewall on"; fi
